Sonarbat is a [[Lightning]] type [[Specialist]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Synthhog]] at 18 stars, and evolves into [[Umbraveil]] at 36 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

== Overview ==
Current Description: "At night, when the Tatari are fast asleep, Sonarbat unleashes those powerful sound waves to knock out any Zobos and ensure absolute peace. Now if only [[Snoozebo]] didn't make so much noise..."

Sonarbat is a red rarity Tatari.

== Evolution Trial ==
Sonarbat's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 36 stars. To evolve it into [[Umbraveil]] you need to complete the following three tasks:
* Feed this Tatari to B quality.
* Play [[Marathon Party]] (use skateboard x6000) or [[Fishing Contest]] (Use Fishing Rod x6000).
* In [[Zobo Horde Invasion|Horde Invasion]], upgrade Sonarbat to Lvl 7 or above for a total of 5 times.

== Trivia ==
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "Is Sonarbat secretly studying finance? If Sonarbat turned out to be a high-IQ criminal, that would be a real headache."
* Prior to the update on 5/12/2026, its bio description said: "Sonarbat's ultrasonic waves can fell [[Zobos]], and it's said that they create a unique resonant melody when paired with [[Toucanzam]]'s song."
